key_insight: XCAPE combines PXRD constraints with physics-guided, machine-learning-accelerated crystal structure searches to infer plausible atomic arrangements.
engineering_relevance: The framework can help resolve uncertain material structures and support automated materials discovery workflows.
method: Constrain a symmetry-aware evolutionary search using composition, unit cell, space group, and PXRD data.
Explore Wyckoff-site configurations with tailored mutations and evaluate candidates by energy and diffraction agreement.
Accelerate geometry optimization with a universal machine-learning interatomic potential.
evidence_signal: XCAPE recovered 71/77 simulated-PXRD benchmarks (92.2%) and 12/12 experimental references; among 12 additional candidate assignments without matching ICSD entries, 10 were within 10 meV/atom of the DFT convex hull.
watch_item: Diffraction agreement and low predicted energy do not guarantee a unique structure, especially when PXRD data are noisy or provide weak elemental contrast.
paper_title: Physics-Guided Crystal Structure Elucidation from Powder X-Ray Diffraction with Universal Machine-Learning Interatomic Potentials
